events.title: Taco Tuesday with DJ Torrey Tee
events.description: Join us this Tuesday as we bring the energy back to the start of the week. Maiz Mexican Catering will be on-site serving a lineup of bold, authentic flavors. Expect fresh tacos, vibrant salsas, and dishes built to pair perfectly with a glass of wine in hand. It’s casual, flavorful, and exactly how a Tuesday should feel. Behind the bar, we’re doing something you’ll only find on Tuesdays. For the first time, we’re pouring Sangria on tap, available exclusively during Taco & Wine Tuesday. Bring your 1-liter flip top bottle and take home our custom house sangria, crafted to be refreshing, fruit-driven, and perfect for the season. No reservations needed. Come out, grab some tacos, and settle in with a glass. Tuesdays just found their rhythm.

events.title: R&B Night
events.description: Join us for R&B Night with DJ Torrey Tee every Wednesday at Christopher Cellars. We’re open from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM , with wines by the glass, bottle, flights, wine slushies and more available all night long. Taeza’s Bottom Line BBQ will be out serving up their slow-smoked BBQ favorites, with smoked meats, hearty sides and plenty of good food to go with a night of wine and R&B. No cover charge. Open seating. Come early, grab a table, order some BBQ and wine, and settle in for the night. Torrey Tee is a Sacramento-based DJ, creative and cultural curator with a talent for turning music into experiences. Known for his ability to read a room and move seamlessly through R&B, Hip-Hop, Bay Area classics, throwbacks and open-format selections, Torrey brings an intentional approach to every set. His style is rooted in creating the right atmosphere, knowing when to set the tone, when to bring the energy and how to make a room feel connected through music. His versatility has taken him across nightlife, weddings, festivals, community events, corporate experiences and some of Sacramento’s most recognizable venues and organizations. Along the way, he’s worked with Macy’s, the City of Sacramento, St. HOPE, Coin-Op, the R&B Running Series and other brands and organizations throughout Northern California. Beyond the booth, Torrey is a photographer, filmmaker, creative entrepreneur and founder of Full Effect Films and Full Effect Entertainment. His work lives at the intersection of music, visuals, culture and community, giving him a unique perspective on creating experiences that are bigger than the music alone. Now bringing that approach to Christopher Cellars as our resident Wednesday night DJ , Torrey is helping create a night centered around great wine, good food, good people and the sounds of R&B. From the records you grew up on to the ones defining the genre today. For Torrey Tee, it’s never just about what’s playing. It’s about how the room feels when it plays. #block-207a02e347ab2b474e2d { } #block-207a02e347ab2b474e2d .sqs-html-content { } #block-207a02e347ab2b474e2d { mix-blend-mode: var(--tweak-text-block-blend ); border-radius: var(--tweak-text-block-radius); } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-207a02e347ab2b474e2d { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-207a02e347ab2b474e2d .sqs-html-content { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { }

events.title: Murder Mystery at The Cellar: A Haunting 40 Years in the Making
events.description: This murder mystery is going to be one for the books! Forty years ago, a mysterious murder took place in the cellar. The crime was never solved, and the victim's spirit has been haunting the grounds ever since. Now, four decades later, the ghost is ready to reveal the truth. But will you be able to uncover the killer before the night is over? Join us at Christopher Cellars for an immersive evening of mystery, suspense, and a little supernatural activity. Arrive dressed in your Halloween best, enjoy a complimentary glass of wine included with your ticket, and prepare to follow the clues, question the suspects, and uncover secrets buried for 40 years. Throughout the evening, enjoy light bites, specialty drinks available for purchase, and take part in a séance where the spirits may hold the final clue to solving the mystery. Your ticket includes: An interactive murder mystery experience One complimentary glass of Christopher Cellars wine Light bites throughout the evening A séance to help uncover the killer Will the spirit finally find peace, or will the truth remain buried in The Cellar? Costumes are encouraged. Mystery awaits. events.title: Fright Night Halloween Party
events.description: We're switching things up this Friday night at Christopher Cellars for a festive Halloween celebration! Join us for an evening of wine, music, costumes, and Halloween fun as DJ Torrey Tee takes over the winery from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM, spinning your favorite hits throughout the evening. Come dressed in your Halloween best and enter our costume contest for a chance to win! We'll be pouring wines by the glass and bottle, along with festive specialty drinks and an exclusive Halloween wine flight featuring wine and candy pairings. Discover how your favorite Halloween treats pair with wine in this fun seasonal tasting experience. We'll also have a food truck on-site serving up delicious food throughout the evening! Whether you're dressing up, dancing along to the music, or simply enjoying a glass of wine with friends, we're looking forward to a lively Friday night at The Cellar!
